newsitem.title: USA: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS - U.S. Corporate Earnings.
newsitem.headline: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS - U.S. Corporate Earnings.

text.p: General Electric Co posted fourth quarter profits this morning that, according to First Call, matched analysts' estimates to the penny. GE earned $1.26 a share for the quarter and $4.40 a share for the year.

Digital Equipment Corp shares were up 3-3/8 at 37-1/2 in early trading after the company's second quarter earnings topped analysts' mean estimate of $0.10 a share. The company earned $0.15 a share, down from $0.91 a year ago.

Automatic Data Processing Inc shares rose 3/4 to 43-3/4 in early trading after its second quarter earnings matched analysts' estimates exactly, at $0.44 a share. A year earlier it earned $0.38 a share.

Georgia-Pacific shares fell 5/8 to 76-1/2 after the company said fourth quarter profits were hurt by a collapse in prices for most products. Its fourth quarter earnings were $0.02 a share. The First Call consensus estimate was $0.38.

Eastman Kodak Co shares jumped 3-7/8 to 85-1/8, a new year high, after its earnings beat Wall Street Estimates by $0.07. The company raised its quarterly dividend and said it was working on improving its cost structure.
Kodak earned $1.19 for the fourth quarter, beating First Call analysts' consensus estimate of $1.12.
Bank of New York Co Inc shares slipped 3/8 to 34-5/8 after its fourth quarter earnings matched First Call's consensus estimate of $0.61 a share. The bank earned $0.56 a share a year earlier.
